reference.criterion: Unmanned intelligent aircraft are the dominant mode of warfare rather than an important additional weapon.
reference.rationale: Drones were important in 2009, but conventional ground and air warfare were not displaced. They are now central in particular theaters, especially Ukraine. The worldwide, cross-domain dominance claim remains only partly fulfilled.
